_comment: Worker safety settings (passed to every worker by start-worker.sh --safety). Replace /ABSOLUTE/PATH with the real absolute path to the coordinator folder on this machine. This is the AUTONOMOUS baseline (the default level): only the protected branches and irreversible removals are guarded; workers do routine risky work themselves and report it. The CAUTIOUS level adds: "Bash(gh pr merge*)", "Bash(gh pr ready*)", "Read(**/.env*)" and the stack candidates chosen in the init quiz (examples/nextjs-supabase/settings.json). Also add gh pr merge / ready denies wherever PROJECT.md says humans merge or mark ready.
